extShortName.description: Short name for the extensions shelf

extDescription.message: Closes the tabs left behind after a video meeting: Zoom, Teams, Meet, Webex, GoTo and seven more platforms.

optionsSubtitle.message: The meeting ended or moved to the desktop app, and the tab stayed behind. This extension closes it for you.

optionsSeconds.message: seconds of you being away from the tab

optionsSafety.message: A tab is never closed while you are looking at it, while it is pinned, while it makes sound, while it plays video, while it holds your camera, microphone or screen, or while it holds a live WebRTC connection. A meeting you are running in the browser, and the lobby before it, are left alone.

optionsUnverified.description: Badge for a platform mapped from documentation only

optionsNeedsPermission.description: Badge for a platform that requires an optional permission

optionsPermissionDenied.message: Without access to the site the extension cannot watch the meeting
optionsPermissionDenied.description: Shown when the permission request is declined

optionsGroupReady.description: Heading for platforms needing no extra permission

optionsGroupReadyHint.message: The link launches the desktop app and the tab is left empty.

optionsGroupOptional.description: Heading for platforms behind an optional permission

optionsGroupOptionalHint.message: These services run the call in the browser, so the extension needs access to their site. It is requested when you tick the box and revoked when you untick it.
